arguments.question: For NVDA and MU over the next 63 trading sessions versus QQQ, review primary filings/results and company releases. Identify dated, quantified demand drivers, guidance/earnings-event timing, operating or supply risks, and only supportable valuation inputs (distinguish quarterly/fiscal data from annual EPS). State evidence that would alter each company assessment. Stop after the latest material primary results plus one filing/companyfacts source per company; do not infer consensus.
arguments.decision_impact: Determines whether company-specific fundamentals and valuation scenarios justify a differentiated NVDA or MU assessment relative to QQQ.
